data.name: Aleen
data.gender_notes: Aleen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is gentle and kind, soft-spoken and compassionate. The name Aleen carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aleen usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the gentle and compassionate nature of Allah
data.etymology: Aleen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aleen total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عَلين
in_arabic.meaning: عالي الدرجة، رفيع الشأن، ذو مكانة عالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عَلين مشتق من العلو، وهو يعني الارتفاع والرفعة في الدرجة والمكانة، ويدل على العزة والكرامة، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: 'وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ أُولَئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدِّيقُونَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمُ الْجَنَّةُ وَالْحُسْنَىٰ ذَلِكَ الْفَضْلُ الْبَيِنُ'

in_urdu.name: علین
in_urdu.meaning: اعلیٰ درجہ، رفیع الشان، ذو مقامہ عالی
in_urdu.long_meaning: علین نام عربی زبان کے 'علو' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند و بالا، عالی مقام، اور رفیع الشان۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفت ہے، جیسے کہ قرآن مجید میں سورہ آل عمران میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलीन
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च पद, उच्च स्थान, महान व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीन नाम का अर्थ उच्च पद, उच्च स्थान और महान व्यक्ति होता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है, क्योंकि यह अल्लाह की विशेषता है, जो कुरआन में उल्लिखित है। यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: عليين
in_pashto.meaning: لوړ رتبه، لوړ شان، سترګو منځن
in_pashto.long_meaning: د (عليين) نوم مطلب د لوړوالي او برترۍ څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د خدای تعالیٰ د صفاتو څخه يو دی، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کريم کې ياد شوی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو په ميراث کې ځای لري.

in_english.name: Aleen
in_english.meaning: High rank, exalted status, noble person
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aleen originates from the Arabic root 'alā', meaning 'to rise' or 'to be high'. It signifies high rank, exalted status, and nobility. In Islamic tradition, Aleen is considered a significant name as it reflects the attributes of Allah. The Quran mentions similar concepts in Surah Al-Imran. Aleen symbolizes spiritual elevation and moral excellence.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عليين

data.cultural_impact: The name Aleen is of Arabic origin, and it is commonly used among Muslims and Arabs. The name reflects the virtues of gentleness, kindness, and compassion, which are highly valued in Islamic society. The name Aleen is also associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) character, as he was known for his kind and gentle demeanor towards all people, regardless of their background or status.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aleen holds great significance as it reminds us of the importance of being gentle and kind towards others. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger." (Al-Bukhari and Muslim). Thus, the name Aleen encourages us to strive for self-control and to treat others with compassion and kindness, as we believe that these qualities are pleasing to Allah Almighty. Additionally, the name Aleen reflects the merciful and compassionate nature of Allah, as mentioned in the Quran, "And when He wraps you [in death] in disorder, [O Prophet], yet He is the Forgiving to the people, Most Merciful." (Quran 81:28). Therefore, the name Aleen serves as a constant reminder of the importance of these virtues in both our daily lives and our spiritual journey towards Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gentle, Kind" symbolizes The one who is gentle and kind, soft-spoken and compassionate. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aleen serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gentle, kind.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aleen was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aleen carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aleen was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is considered a companion of the Prophet Muhammad.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aleen remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
